study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Taylor R. Young, Vinod Jangir Kumar, and Manojkumar Saranathan; Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging; 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative Modeling of Thalamic Nuclear Volumes and Characterization of Lateralized Volume Alterations in Alzheimer's Disease Versus Schizophrenia

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive models of location, shape, and scale (GAMLSS) multivariate model was the top-performing model and used for the primary analysis. Ordinary least squares regression (OLSR) and multiple fractional polynomial regression (MFPR) were compared.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Ordinary least squares regression, multiple fractional polynomial regression, and generalized additive models of location, shape, and scale (GAMLSS) were compared as predictive models using both univariate and multivariate models that accounted for the effects of age, sex, TIV, and site. ... The multivariate GAMLSS model with age, sex, eTIV, and site as covariates was the overall top-performing model.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Young2024.pdf.md: METHODS / Normative Modeling; RESULTS / Normative Model Comparison and Evaluation

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Volumes of 10 thalamic nuclei (anteroventral, pulvinar, lateral geniculate nucleus, medial geniculate nucleus, medial dorsal-parafasicular, centromedian, ventral anterior, ventral lateral anterior, ventral lateral posterior, and ventral posterolateral), bilateral whole thalami, and their laterality indices (LI).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Volumes of bilateral whole thalami and 10 thalamic nuclei were generated from T1 magnetic resonance imaging data ... Normative models for each nucleus were generated from healthy control participants ... To assess left versus right hemisphere differences in structures, the laterality index (LI) de ned as LI = (V_L - V_R) / (V_L + V_R) was computed for each nucleus.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Young2024.pdf.md: ABSTRACT / METHODS; METHODS AND MATERIALS / Thalamic Nuclei Segmentation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The multivariate model included age, sex, estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV), and site as covariates.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The multivariate GAMLSS model with age, sex, eTIV, and site as covariates was the overall top-performing model.
